backend/main.mo: Actor exposes admission prediction based on percentile-to-rank conversion and provides simple cutoff list queries.
backend/migration.mo: Migration initializes new actor state with an empty cutoffs list.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of main frontend files for documentation or planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and extensive OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component that renders the MHT-CET predictor form page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creates and caches authenticated or anonymous backend actors and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context with login, clear, and identity persistence logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base file defining warm earth-tone OKLCH color system and dark mode variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/MhtCetPredictorFormPa: Full predictor form UI handling percentile input, backend calls, error states, loading, and results rendering.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending colors, radii, fonts, and animations using OKLCH theme variables.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current version, goals, architecture notes, and existing frontend features for an MHT-CET college predictor web app. Outlines planned backend logic, SQLite cutoff storage, and placeholder predictor functionality.
